About Brightside Plumbing

Brightside Plumbing was founded by Dana Whitfield in 1998 with one van and a promise to turn up when we say we will.

Today we are a team of nine licensed plumbers and two apprentices, still family-run and still based on Alder Street in Riverton.

How we work

  • We call ahead when we are on our way.
  • We wear shoe covers and lay down dust sheets.
  • We explain what we found and what it will take to fix it before we start.

Dana still answers the phone most mornings, so do not be surprised if the owner picks up.

Brightside Plumbing, 214 Alder Street, Riverton. Licence no. PL-48213.
